tool.name: DICOMweb: Import Series
tool.description: Import a de-identified series from the research plane
tool.help:
Downloads a DICOM series via WADO-RS from the source named in the input DICOM Reference.
The source must be a **research-plane** endpoint (registered with role ``research``). The research plane holds only de-identified, governed, manifest-tracked copies made by the manifest service's materialization step; this tool verifies each instance declares ``PatientIdentityRemoved=YES`` and imports it unchanged. It refuses a clinical source: materialize the selection first, then import.
Nothing is de-identified here. That happens once, under a persisted scope key, where the manifest records it and end-of-retention destruction can find it.
